project_info.name: Jarjus Lawn Care LLC Marketing Platform
project_info.tagline: Precision Turf & Agrarian Care across Neoga and Central Illinois

design_identity.description: High-impact agrarian editorial design combining rich deep forest green, limestone bone neutrals, and solar wheat ochre accents. Emphasizes tactile craftsmanship, deep Midwest roots, and precise typography rather than generic tech SaaS tropes.
anti_patterns: No Inter font for main or sub-headings
No purple or tech gradients (#7351B7 forbidden)
No generic full-screen backdrop overlays over 50% black
No transparent dropdown menus or unreadable navigation headers

headings.usage: H1 Hero, Section Titles, Large Statement Numbers, Editorial Headlines

body.usage: Paragraphs, Service tier descriptions, Contact details, Form fields, Badges

accent_mono.usage: Pricing tags, Acreage indicators, Service area tags, Overlines, Geo-coordinates

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-[1.05]
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
scale.subtitle: text-lg sm:text-xl text-stone-600 font-normal leading-relaxed
scale.small: text-xs sm:text-sm text-stone-500 uppercase font-mono tracking-wider

color_system.contrast_policy: All body text meets WCAG AA (>= 4.5:1 ratio). Primary CTA uses solid deep forest green (#1B3B2B) with crisp white (#FAF8F5) text or warm golden accent (#C88A2B) on dark panels.

layout_and_sections.name: Floating Glass & Wood Navigation
layout_and_sections.description: Sticky top bar with glassmorphism backdrop (backdrop-blur-md bg-[#F7F5F0]/85 border-b border-[#E2DDD2]), brand mark 'Jarjus Lawn Care LLC', navigation links, call button, and quote CTA button.

layout_and_sections.name: Kinetic Hero with Line Reveal & Parallax
layout_and_sections.description: Full-width editorial hero. Headline: 'Agrarian Turf Care Crafted for Central Illinois Grounds.' Masked line-by-line reveal animation using framer-motion, floating stats badge ('3528 E 930 N, Neoga, IL'), and immediate quote trigger button.

layout_and_sections.name: Central Illinois Towns Marquee
layout_and_sections.description: Continuous slow-moving editorial ribbon highlighting the 8 core service towns: Neoga, Effingham, Mattoon, Charleston, Toledo, Shumway, Sigel, Montrose IL.

layout_and_sections.name: Numbered Why-Us Agrarian Chapters
layout_and_sections.description: Asymmetric Bento grid detailing Jarjus Lawn Care's local family principles: 01/ Local Ownership, 02/ Precision Edging & Clean Cut Guarantee, 03/ Reliability in Rural Weather.

layout_and_sections.name: Services & 'Starting At' Tiered Pricing
layout_and_sections.description: High-density pricing card matrix with acreage breakdowns: Up to 1/4 acre ($41–$61), 1/4–1/2 acre ($49–$69), 1/2–1 acre ($59–$114). Features interactive lot-size estimator, clear 'Final quotes depend on lot size & condition' disclaimers, and direct 'Get a Quote' action buttons.

layout_and_sections.name: Central Illinois Coverage Grid & Interactive Map
layout_and_sections.description: Comprehensive regional coverage section explicitly showcasing Neoga, Effingham, Mattoon, Charleston, Toledo, Shumway, Sigel, and Montrose IL with driving radius badges and quick contact callouts.

layout_and_sections.name: Client Reviews & Google Reviews Link
layout_and_sections.description: Curated quote carousel / grid from local property owners + high-visibility 'Read our reviews' button linking out to Google Business reviews.

layout_and_sections.name: Contact & Quote Request Panel
layout_and_sections.description: Dual-column layout featuring full address (3528 East 930 North, Neoga, IL 62447), phone link ((217) 294-2346), quick quote form with lot size selector, and emergency lawn care dispatch inquiry.

layout_and_sections.name: Editorial Footer & Local Business SEO Schema
layout_and_sections.description: Dark forest green footer with large brand typographic mark, full business credentials, navigation map, embedded LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema, and SEO meta compliance.

motion_and_effects.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scroll integration for organic physical momentum
motion_and_effects.hero_animation: Line-by-line staggered Y-translation with opacity mask reveal
motion_and_effects.scroll_reveal: Framer Motion initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 24 }} whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
motion_and_effects.reduced_motion: Supported via prefers-reduced-motion fallback disabling heavy transforms

seo_and_schema.title: Jarjus Lawn Care LLC | Professional Lawn Care in Neoga, IL & Central Illinois
seo_and_schema.meta_description: Premier lawn care, precision mowing, and yard maintenance in Neoga, Effingham, Mattoon, Charleston, Toledo, Shumway, Sigel, and Montrose IL. Call (217) 294-2346 for custom lot quotes.

testing_and_attributes.data_testid_convention: kebab-case role-based attributes on all interactive elements

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a stunning single-page React marketing application at src/App.js with modular component files in src/components/.
Ensure all pricing lines are prominent: Up to 1/4 acre $41–$61, 1/4–1/2 acre $49–$69, 1/2–1 acre $59–$114, with explicit lot condition disclaimer.
Implement the Google Reviews button linking to Google Business search for Jarjus Lawn Care.
Ensure all 8 towns (Neoga, Effingham, Mattoon, Charleston, Toledo, Shumway, Sigel, Montrose) are featured in both marquee and dedicated service area grid.
Structure the HTML so that full textual content (services, prices, contact, towns, reviews) is rendered in baseline markup for rural slow connections / non-JS visibility.
Inject the JSON-LD schema into document header or react-helmet/script tag.
Apply all test-id attributes specified in key_test_ids.
